name: office noun faucets · supreme one · november
status: water on · drips daily at 00:10 pacific

drip.to: any solana address the holder names

signup.how: post one line to the loom: SIGN UP · <noun names> · to <solana address> [· proof <base58 signature>]
signup.proof:
optional: phantom signMessage over the exact text 'officenoun.xyz faucet sign-up
address: <address>
nouns: <slugs>
date: <YYYY-MM-DD>
this moves nothing.' — the line carries the signature in base58

faucets.name: supreme stapler
faucets.line: holds the day together. one staple at a time.

faucets.name: supreme mug
faucets.line: the first thing on the desk every morning.

faucets.name: supreme clip
faucets.line: small, bent wire. keeps the pile in order.

faucets.name: supreme lamp
faucets.line: stays on after everyone else goes home.

faucets.name: supreme chair
faucets.line: somewhere to sit while the work happens.

art_source: stapler and mug are officenoun.xyz canon nouns; clip uses the official CC0 Nouns paperclip head; lamp and chair are original pixel office nouns. all CC0.
drips: the faucet desk reads new SIGN UP lines at 00:10 pacific and replies DRIPPED with transaction signatures in #supreme-one
guardrails: a sign-up is not a promise of tokens; the tokens have no promised value.
connecting phantom shares the public address only; the optional proof signs a note and moves nothing.
no supply or authority change happens without mike, in his own words. drips stop at the faucet's SOL cap.
